q1_issues.issue: The Name string drops 'Old' even though the name is defined as exactly its capitalized run of words, which here is 'Old Vesh' (symbol old_vesh, one Name fact carrying the full surface form).

(Member vesh old) turns the capitalized premodifier into structure, which the mechanical casing rule bars for a capitalized modifier joining a name ('Upper Calderwick' gets no (Member ... upper)) and which the courtesy/kinship-title route would likewise keep as surface inside the Name string.

q2_gaps: A SENTENCE-INITIAL capitalized modifier before a proper noun ('Old Vesh attends ...'): the name rule decides name-hood 'by the casing itself, mechanically', but sentence-initial capitalization is orthographic and cannot distinguish a name-joining modifier from an ordinary predicative adjective, and no rule exempts that position.

A DETERMINERLESS capitalized institutional noun as a direct object ('attends Council'): the capitalized-common-noun-label rule presumes a definite ('the Assembly' -> 'definite handling as usual'), while the bare-class-symbol licence is reserved for non-specific / generic objects and forbidden for a specific definite individual, so a bare institutional 'Council' falls between the two.
notes: Everything else is right: Agent for the transitive subject, Theme for an unchanged direct object, no status atom on the present habitual, and correctly no Name atom for 'Council'.
